title: Yarn lockfile pins an absolute registry URL
description: yarn.lock declares a resolution that hard-codes a registry tarball URL instead of a version range. The lockfile stops following the configured registry, so a mirror, an air-gapped build or a policy change cannot redirect it.
remediation: Record the resolution as a version range and let the configured registry serve it.
limitation: It matches a resolution that hard-codes a registry tarball URL instead of a version range in the parsed yarn.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
